# Judith Chapter 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Judith 6 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/JDT_006_page_001.jpg

---

**6:1** And when the-tumult of-the men who-were around the-council had-ceased, Holofernes the-chief-general of-the army of Assyria said to Achior and to all the-sons of Moab before all the-assembled-people of-the foreigners:

**6:2** "And who are you, Achior, and the-hired-men of Ephraim, that you-have-prophesied among us today and said that we-should-not make-war against the-race of Israel because their God will-defend them? And who is God except Nebuchadnezzar? He will-send forth his-might and will-destroy them from-upon the-face of-the earth, and their God will-not save them.

**6:3** But we his-servants will-strike them as one man, and they-will-not be-able to-withstand the-force of-our horses.

**6:4** For we-will-burn them in-[their] midst, and their mountains will-be-drunk with their blood, and their plains will-be-filled with their dead. And their footprints will-not-stand before our face — but they will-utterly-perish, says the-king Nebuchadnezzar, lord of all the-earth. For he spoke: none of his-words will-be-idle.

**6:5** But you, Achior, hired-man of Ammon, who have-spoken these words in-the day of your-iniquity, you will-not see my-face from this day until I-take-vengeance on this race that-came out-of Egypt.

**6:6** And then the-iron of my-army and the-multitude of those-serving-me will-pass-through your-sides and you will-fall among their wounded when I-return.

**6:7** And my-servants will-carry you off into the-hill-country and will-place you in one of-the cities of-the ascents.

**6:8** And you will-not perish until you-are-destroyed with them.

**6:9** And if you-hope in your-heart that they-will-not be-taken, let-not your-face fall. I-have-spoken, and not one of my-words will-prove-empty."

**6:10** And Holofernes commanded his-servants who-were standing ready in his-tent to-seize Achior and to-take-him-away to Bethulia and to-deliver him into the-hands of-the sons of Israel.

**6:11** And his-servants seized him and took-him-away outside the-camp into the-plain, and they-moved from the-midst of-the plain into the-hill-country and came to the-springs which were below Bethulia.

**6:12** And when the-men of-the city saw them on-the summit of-the hill, they-took-up their weapons and went out of-the city to-the top of-the hill. And every slinger held them at-bay and prevented them from-going-up by throwing-stones at them.

**6:13** And they-went-under the-hill and bound Achior and left him at-the-foot of-the hill and returned to their-lord.

**6:14** And the-sons of Israel came down from their-city and found him and loosed him and led him into Bethulia and presented him before the-leaders of their-city,

**6:15** who were in those days Uzziah son of Micah from the-tribe of Simeon, and Chabris son of Gothoniel, and Charmis son of Melchiel.

**6:16** And they-called-together all the-elders of-the city, and all their-young-men ran-together and the-women also to the-assembly. And they-stood Achior in-the midst of all their-people, and Uzziah questioned him concerning the-things that-had-happened.

**6:17** And he-answered and declared to-them the-words of-the council of Holofernes, and all the-things that he-had-spoken in-the midst of the-leaders of-the sons of Assyria, and all the-great-things that Holofernes had-boasted against the-house of Israel.

**6:18** And the-people fell-down and worshiped God and cried-out:

**6:19** "O Lord God of heaven, behold their-arrogance and have-mercy on the-lowliness of our-race, and look upon the-face of those-who-have-been-consecrated to you this day."

**6:20** And they-comforted Achior and praised him greatly.

**6:21** And Uzziah took him from the-assembly into his-house and made a feast for the-elders. And they-called-upon the-God of Israel for-help all that-night.
